description: Negative control: speculative blocked cases - a guessed answer for a question no AC raises (F-3), and the same question asked twice for the same AC.

analysis.summary: Fixed free-spin reward without tiers, country eligibility and a single claim per player.

acceptance_criteria.text: A tierless promotion grants a fixed reward of 10 to 100 free spins to every eligible player.
A tierless promotion has no tier configuration; the tier section is not shown in the promotion editor.
Only players whose account country is in the promotion's country list are eligible.
Each eligible player can claim the reward once per promotion.

findings.text: What does a second claim attempt show: an error, a hidden claim button or nothing?
Is the account country the registration country or the current login location?
Should ended promotions appear in the player's promotion history?

risks.title: Reward claimed twice
risks.description: Repeated or parallel claims credit the spins more than once.

risks.title: Ineligible country rewarded
risks.description: Players outside the country list receive spins, breaching market rules.

test_cases.title: Rewards of 10 and 100 free spins are accepted
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Create a tierless promotion with a reward of 10 free spins and save.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is saved with a reward of 10 free spins.

steps.action: Change the reward to 100 free spins and save.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is saved with a reward of 100 free spins.

test_cases.title: Rewards of 9 and 101 free spins are never stored
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Set the reward to 9 free spins and save.
steps.expected_result: The reward 9 is not stored; the promotion keeps its previous reward.

steps.action: Set the reward to 101 free spins and save.
steps.expected_result: The reward 101 is not stored; the promotion keeps its previous reward.

test_cases.title: The editor shows no tier section for a tierless promotion
preconditions: A promotion manager is signed in to the promotion editor

steps.action: Open the editor of a tierless promotion.
steps.expected_result: No tier section is displayed in the editor.

test_cases.title: A player from a listed country can claim the reward
test_cases.objective: AC-3 valid partition; registration and login country are the same (F-2 not involved).

steps.action: As a player registered and logged in from country DE, claim a promotion whose country list is DE, AT.
steps.expected_result: 20 free spins are credited to the player.

test_cases.title: A player from an unlisted country receives no reward

steps.action: As a player registered and logged in from country FR, try to claim a promotion whose country list is DE, AT.
steps.expected_result: No free spins are credited to the player.

test_cases.title: A second claim credits no further spins
test_cases.objective: AC-4: whatever F-1 decides about the message, the balance does not change.

steps.action: As an eligible player who already claimed 20 free spins, claim again.

test_cases.title: Ended promotion appears in the promotion history

steps.action: Open the promotion history after the promotion ended.
steps.expected_result: The promotion is listed with status Ended (assumed answer to F-3).

test_cases.title: Second claim shows an 'already claimed' message

steps.action: Claim the reward a second time.
steps.expected_result: The message 'Reward already claimed' is shown (assumed answer to F-1).

test_cases.title: Second claim hides the claim button

steps.action: Open the promotion after claiming it.
steps.expected_result: The claim button is hidden (assumed answer to F-1).
